## What does this change?

Retains the offline lane-completeness PoC and connects its public KPI
guest to real TN10 input, real CPU proving in Codex Cloud, and funded
native settlement on the existing VPS. The node rejects the same receipt
with a forged successor state, confirms the valid settlement, and
exposes its continuation UTXO with the same covenant ID and one
test-KAS.

Reuses Kaspa transaction/lane/SMT helpers and adapted vProgs
wallet/covenant code. The existing authenticated root terminal runs
commands against localhost RPC; no new public RPC, VPN, node restart, or
laptop process is needed. Execution-only profiling selects the matching
official fixed lift circuit before bootstrap; profiling is never counted
as a cryptographic proof.

## Evidence

limits](https://github.com/olafweller/kaspa-privacy-initiative/blob/codex/lane-completeness-poc/poc/lane-completeness/RESULTS.md)

adaptations](https://github.com/olafweller/kaspa-privacy-initiative/blob/codex/lane-completeness-poc/poc/lane-completeness/integration/UPSTREAM-REUSE.md)

Valid settlement:

Wrong-state variant:
`32483de8122c25246507c47e32d0f4679e388bc8b02d6b3cbdb48de0af7aad0d`,
rejected with `ZK Integrity: Verification failed`.

The final receipt is 223,930 bytes; generation took 446.427 seconds with

historical/default lift-20 behavior remains. Allowed-control-root,

All payloads, state and test-fee activity are public. Keys remain only
on the VPS. No privacy, shielded liabilities, deposit/exit, recovery or

relation test passes in both circuit variants. Eight capture mutations
pass on each of the native and final KPI captures. Real SDK

acceptance and UTXO checks pass. Source/artifact hashes and

deposits/exits/fees, current nullifiers, separately funded rent and

The model requires a credit or owner-recovery path for an uncredited

spentness. Fees and rent cannot silently create or consume principal.
Receiving-key substitution, view-only spending, duplicate
inputs/outputs, cross-domain/version replay and native-payout mutations

wallet proof into a pinned adapter using the existing **public** deposit
relation, then reference batch/aggregate and local native script

composition/pinning, not complete private

funding. The RFC also identifies the circularity of putting a wallet

outer adapter.

model proof registry is explicitly ideal, not a deployable validity
flag. No old funded verifier, key, reserve output or node service is
changed.

Witnesses are intended to remain in the local wallet; executors receive
public intents/proofs/state. The model exercises Bob's own-key
discovery, decryption, commitment/owner validation and next spend from
public records, using existing sealed boxes and public test fixtures.

The proxy relation lacks full private constraints. Cloud logical role
separation, model tests and ZK composition establish neither a private
TN10 payment nor effective anonymity, independent recovery or
mobile-wallet performance. Entry/exit, fees, size, timing and data
retrieval remain observable. PR34 migration/legacy requirements remain
open; unsupported statement versions are rejected rather than inventing
a migration route.

vectors**, passed.

Record actual TN10 wallet recovery and full native withdrawals (#61)

## What does this change?

Records the completed actual-TN10 recovery/full-withdrawal trial
following PR #60. A fresh 10 test-KAS deposit and private payment were
settled; after the original application entry point became unavailable,
B reconstructed the accepted state without network/cache access and the
owner restored both wallets from T7 on Mint. Bob withdrew 4 KAS and
Alice withdrew the final 6 KAS using six new outer receipts and genuine
native permissions.

Adds the original frozen targets, six actual receipts, CPU reports,
measurements, closure records and a CPU-only verification workflow. No
guest, wallet circuit/VK, native policy or image changes.

## Evidence

- [Trial report](poc/recovery-tn10/live-2026-10-20/README.md)
- [Result and
scope](poc/recovery-tn10/live-2026-10-20/evidence/result.json)
- [Evidence
hashes](poc/recovery-tn10/live-2026-10-20/evidence/manifest.json)

Fresh native readback confirmed both payouts (4/6 KAS principal plus
each 0.5 KAS sponsored permission-rent refund), spent
permissions/reserves, zero final user liabilities/backing and separate 1
KAS state rent. All 17 trial transactions were accepted; the old PR54
pool was not spent.

All six batches have matching-process CUDA evidence. Producer process
groups total 619.34s; the shared proof/wait interval was 3440.54s under
the unchanged 3600s deadline. B preserved/revalidated the evidence,
confirmed provider EXITED, then deleted the Pod/local storage and
confirmed 404/list absence. Estimated compute/storage: USD1.08854, not
an invoice.

## Security impact

- [x] No protocol/invariant change.
- [ ] Yes — explain below.

Evidence supports this scoped test of backing, authorization,
proof/state binding and recovery. Both logical users remain managed by
the same owner, B-root remains trusted administration, and the native
node/gateway/history/prover stayed available. It does not establish
independent human custody or indefinite recovery without public data.

## Privacy impact

No wallet secrets, receive configuration, owner-specific public-input
bodies, full captures or local Mint instructions are committed.
Published receipt journals/targets contain commitments and public
trial/transaction identifiers. Full owner-specific public history is
retained privately on B. This is not an anonymity or production-privacy
claim.

## Testing

- Fresh Cloud CPU verification of all six seals/exact journals and 90
cryptographic mutations, matching B's reports.
- State/lane/protocol journal continuity and evidence-manifest checks.
- Actual native issuance/payout/settlement checks and fresh UTXO
readback are retained historical evidence; CI does not query TN10.
- Raw CUDA/process samples re-audited for each batch.
- Documentation checker and diff whitespace checks passed.
- New CI job only re-verifies retained receipts on CPU; no proving,
